product_family: Real-time engagement platform for voice, video, chat, and conversational AI. Core products include Video Calling, Voice Calling, Interactive Live Streaming, Broadcast Streaming, Chat, Interactive Whiteboard, Signaling, IoT, and Conversational AI Engine (for AI agents with voice/avatar capabilities).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Agora's SOC 2 compliance is monitored by Deloitte LLP. A SOC 2 report shows how well Agora manages and protects your data, focusing on key areas like the security, availability, integrity, and privacy of the systems that handle your information.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 provides guidance for establishing and maintaining an information security management system across organizations of any size.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 offers guidance and recommendations of implementing cloud-specific information security controls that complement ISO 27001 standards.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27018:2019 is an international privacy certification extending information security management to protect personal data when being processed in a public cloud.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 is referenced as a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS), a framework to manage personally identifiable information for both data controllers and processors.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Agora is aligned with GDPR and is committed to providing GDPR-compliant products and services to customers in the EU region or with customers who conduct business within the EU.

certifications.name: HIPAA Business Associate
certifications.proof_quote: Agora performs the role of a Business Associate under the definitions of HIPAA and maintains an ongoing HIPAA compliance program.

certifications.name: CCPA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Agora is aligned with CCPA through information security and privacy programs.

certifications.name: COPPA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Agora complies with COPPA requirements for protecting children's information.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on agora.io domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Certification
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on agora.io domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on agora.io domain.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on agora.io domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Agora explicitly states: 'Agora does not use Personal Information processed through the Conversational AI Engine or Agent Studio to train its own AI models.' However, third-party AI providers (LLM providers, ASR, TTS) integrated by customers may process data per their own terms, which may include model training or logging.
privacy.data_region: Geographic routing available across six regions; customers can constrain data within specific geographic boundaries for compliance (GDPR, etc.).

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: AES 128-bit and AES 256-bit encryption available. Encryption keys managed by customers outside Agora's network.

security.name: Data Minimization
security.value: Does not access or store personally identifiable information (PII). Collects only operational data necessary for service delivery: IP addresses for geolocation, install IDs for troubleshooting, and metering data.

security.name: Geographic Data Routing
security.value: Six-region global network with geography-based routing allowing customers to constrain data within specific geographic boundaries.

security.name: Authentication & Geofencing
security.value: Multiple security options available including authentication, encryption, and network geofencing.

security.name: Third-Party Audits
security.value: SOC 2 audits by Deloitte LLP; ISO certifications verified by Ernst & Young LLP and DNV GL.

products.name: Video Calling
products.data_scope: Video streams, metadata, minimal operational data
products.notes: Core real-time video product with GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 compliance.

products.name: Voice Calling
products.data_scope: Audio streams, metadata, minimal operational data
products.notes: Real-time voice with end-to-end encryption option.

products.name: Conversational AI Engine
products.data_scope: Voice/text inputs, AI agent interactions, transcripts (per customer configuration)
products.notes: Agora does NOT train on customer data processed through this engine. Third-party AI providers may have their own terms.

products.name: Live Avatars
products.data_scope: Avatar parameters, video synthesis, audio sync
products.notes: Realistic virtual avatars synced to speech with ultra-low latency.

products.name: Signaling
products.notes: Low-latency signaling layer for custom real-time apps.

products.name: Real-Time Speech to Text (Transcription)
products.notes: Live captions and transcripts; retention per customer configuration (default 30 days).

products.name: Recording
products.data_scope: Audio, video, and web page recordings
products.notes: Flexible recording options for archive, review, or distribution.

compare.pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go based on usage minutes and features; free tier with 10,000 free minutes to start.
compare.data_residency: Geographic routing across six regions; customers can select region(s) for compliance (GDPR, etc.).

flags: Third-party AI provider terms: When customers integrate their own LLM, ASR, or TTS providers (e.g., OpenAI, Google, Twilio), those providers operate under their own terms which may include data retention, logging, or model training. This is disclosed in privacy policy but worth noting in comparisons.

Terms of Service grants broad license: ToS grants Agora rights to 'use, host, store, transfer, publicly display' user content, but this is limited to service delivery and is standard for SaaS platforms. Privacy policy clarifies no PII is accessed independently.
HIPAA as opt-in: HIPAA compliance is optional (with BAA) and not default for all customers—only those requiring it need to engage.
